Susan Electricals IPO Overview
                                                                                                    
                                                        Sector Update

                                                        
                                                            Susan Electricals India Limited operates in the manufacturing of aluminum and copper-based electrical winding wires, conductors and cables in various specifications, sizes and configurations. The Indian wires and cables market is projected to grow from USD 10.32 billion in 2025 to USD 22.35 billion by 2035, registering a CAGR of 8.02%.
                                                        
                                                    
                                                                                                                                                    
                                                        Growth drivers
                                                        
                                                            The Company’s growth is driven by


	Electrification and distribution network expansion
	Infrastructure and urban development activity
	Renewable energy and grid-integration requirements
	Transportation and mobility electrification
	AI-led data centres and digital infrastructure expansion
